crossRefs.note: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy…
Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
crossRefs.keyword: come before his presence. Heb. prevent his face

crossRefs.note: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

translations.web: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
translations.bsb: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
translations.kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
translations.asv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
